en.headline: Police arrest two men over Kowloon break-in spree worth HK$1.7 million
en.dek: A 54-year-old mainland man and a 34-year-old local man were detained over at least nine residential burglaries in Kowloon since July, with losses including cash, watches and jewellery.
body: Hong Kong police have arrested two men in connection with a series of break-ins across Kowloon over the past three months, with total losses estimated at about HK$1.7 million. The suspects are a 54-year-old mainland Chinese man and a 34-year-old Hong Kong resident.

Senior Inspector Tsang Ka-chun of the Kowloon City district crime squad said the pair were identified after a break-in on 14 October targeting four flats in a private building on Farm Road in Kowloon City. Cash, watches and credit cards worth about HK$100,000 were taken in that incident, with further unauthorised transactions on the cards.

Investigations linked the men to five other similar burglaries between July and October in Waterloo Road and Yen Ping Road areas. Police said the suspects entered through kitchens or balconies at night. The mainland man faces charges of burglary and illegal entry, while the local man is accused of handling stolen goods and obtaining property by deception.

zh.headline: 警方拘捕兩男涉九龍區連環爆竊 損失約170萬
zh.dek: 54歲內地男子及34歲本地男子被控涉及自七月以來至少九宗住宅爆竊，失物包括現金、手錶及珠寶。
body: 警方拘捕兩名男子，涉嫌涉及過去三個月在九龍區多宗住宅爆竊案，總損失約170萬港元。被捕者為54歲內地男子及34歲本地男子。
九龍城警區重案組高級督察曾嘉俊表示，兩人於10月14日在九龍城農圃道一幢私人住宅四個單位爆竊後被識別。該案損失現金、名貴手錶及信用卡等約10萬元，其後有未經授權交易。
調查顯示，兩人與7月至10月期間在窩打老道及延坪道另外五宗手法相似的爆竊案有關。警方指疑犯多於深夜經廚房窗或露台門潛入。內地男子被控入屋犯法及非法入境，本地男子則涉處理贓物及以欺騙手段取得財產。
